artifact.layout: little-endian f32: w1[2048xR row-major, x@W convention] || w2[Rx1536 row-major] || u1[1536xR row-major] || u2[Rx1536 row-major] || b_z[1536] || b_h[1536] || zeta_raw[1] || nu_raw[1]

design: docs/adr/024-run2-trained-thought-adapter-ladder.md M4 (frozen FastGRNN cell, low-rank, sub-rung ladder r in {64,128,256} ascending; leakage rule per section 'Leakage discipline')

env.evidence_label: seeded deterministic GPU training (candle 0.9.2 AdamW) over captured per-token pairs; the pairs are live-model capture output (run2-pertoken-dump-receipt.json, evidence label live-model, single-host, simulation-free)

eval_plan_frozen.cell_scope: S2-winner cell L18->L14 only, matching M3; anchor cell deliberately not probed (unregistered extra draw)
eval_plan_frozen.gate: aligned_real (FastGRNN payload) > random, one-sided exact sign test, p < 0.05
eval_plan_frozen.payload_derivation: AUTHORIAL CHOICE, recorded here before the probe (ADR-024's M4 text fixes the architecture and gate but not the pooling step): the FastGRNN consumes the sender's full generated-span per-token L18 sequence from h_0 = 0 and emits the translated sequence h_1..h_T; the 8-slot injection payload is the mean-pool (f64 accumulation) of that TRANSLATED sequence — sequence processing upstream of the pool, the direct sequence analog of M3's variant (i), which is exactly the pooling-hypothesis contrast M4 exists to test
eval_plan_frozen.probe: ADR-023 frozen 40-item S1a/S2b protocol, inherited unchanged (item_seed_chacha8 20897 == 0x51A1, one-sided exact sign test alpha=0.05, 8 slots, rescale-to-natural-median, greedy/batch=1/max 400 tokens)
eval_plan_frozen.sub_rung_order: r=64 first; on gate fail r=128 is trained+probed; on fail r=256; each rank one training run + one probe run, ALL receipts kept regardless of outcome (ADR-024's registered exception: three pre-declared architectures in a pre-declared order, not a sweep-until-pass)

results.rel_residual_formula: sqrt(sum ||pred-y||^2 / sum ||y-mu_r||^2) over holdout tokens, mu_r = fit-side per-dim mean (verbatim M3 formula for direct M3-vs-M4 comparability)

split.rule: fit_holdout_split(2560, FIT_SPLIT_SEED) BY ITEM first (replica of harness/latentmesh-live/src/calibrate.rs:115, replica==harness ground truth pinned by unit test), THEN the 13 probe-overlap rows dropped from whichever side they landed in (ADR-024 frozen leakage rule); sequence windows are drawn WITHIN fit items only (no cross-item sequences)

training.architecture: low-rank FastGRNN cell, D_in 2048 -> D_h 1536, r=64 (shared W,U between gate and candidate; W=W1@W2, U=U1@U2; h_t = z*h_prev + (sigmoid(zeta)(1-z)+sigmoid(nu))*h_tilde; Kusupati et al. arXiv:1901.02358, equations per M0 scout primary fetch)
training.disclosure_train_eval_mismatch: training sees only 16-step zero-init windows; holdout metric and probe run the full sequence (100-400 steps) from h0=0 — long-horizon behavior beyond 16 steps is not directly trained; checkpoint selection on the full-sequence metric guards against a diverging artifact reaching the probe, and the mismatch is disclosed here rather than hidden
training.init: factor matrices U(-1/sqrt(fan_in), +1/sqrt(fan_in)) from one seeded ChaCha8 stream in artifact-layout order; b_z=b_h=0; zeta_raw=1.0, nu_raw=-4.0 (EdgeML reference-implementation defaults, adopted because the scout pinned the equations but not the init)
training.loss: MSE over all window steps (teacher-forced-capture states on both sides)
training.note_no_discarded_runs: single training run at this rank; no restarts, no hyperparameter retries

optimizer.name: AdamW (candle-nn 0.9.2, the only Adam variant shipped — ADR-024 frozen optimizer constraint)

sequences.windowing: within-item tiling from offset 0, stride 16, plus one tail window ending at T_i when T_i % 16 != 0 (min gen_len 100 => all windows full-length); h_0 = 0 per window; full 16-step BPTT (M0 scout's proven pattern, batch 64 x seq 16)

training.stopping_rule: fixed 10-epoch budget; artifact = epoch checkpoint with lowest FULL-SEQUENCE holdout MSE (each holdout item's whole generated span forward from h0=0 — the probe's exact forward, so selection matches deployment; frozen in this receipt before any frozen-probe invocation, ADR-024: the probe-invocation order is the freeze point)
